name: Wooden Bed
description: A spacious solid wood bed with a firm cotton mattress, crisp bedsheet, and soft pillows.

stateDescriptions.neat: The bedsheet is smoothly pulled tight with the pillows fluffed up neatly.
stateDescriptions.rumpled: The blanket is crumpled and the pillows are indented from use.
stateDescriptions.occupied_lying: Someone is resting comfortably in the bed.
stateDescriptions.occupied_sitting: Someone is sitting upright on the edge of the mattress.

name: Bedside Table
description: A small wooden nightstand supporting a brass lamp and personal items.

name: Bedside Lamp
description: A warm reading lamp with an antique brass base and a cloth shade.

stateDescriptions.off: The lamp is unlit, waiting for the evening.
stateDescriptions.on: A soothing golden glow radiates from underneath the lampshade.

name: Teakwood Wardrobe
description: A large double-door wardrobe smelling faintly of camphor and fresh cotton.

stateDescriptions.closed: The twin wooden doors are shut tight.
stateDescriptions.open: Hangers, neatly folded kurtas, jeans, and casual clothes are displayed inside.

name: Copper Water Flask
description: A traditional hammered copper bottle filled with cool drinking water.

stateDescriptions.full: The flask is heavy and cool to the touch, brimming with water.
stateDescriptions.half: The flask has a comfortable amount of water left.
stateDescriptions.empty: The copper bottle is empty and hollow.

name: Study Desk
description: A heavy wooden work desk with pen stands, a notebook, and adequate workspace.

name: Desk Chair
description: A cushioned revolving desk chair offering great back support.

stateDescriptions.available: The chair is empty, waiting at the desk.
stateDescriptions.occupied: Someone is seated comfortably at the workstation.

name: Desktop Computer
description: A dual-monitor workstation with a mechanical keyboard and quiet PC tower.

stateDescriptions.off: The dark monitors reflect the quiet room.
stateDescriptions.on: The wallpaper glows invitingly, ready for work or gaming.
stateDescriptions.in_use: Code, articles, and media flicker across the glowing monitors.

name: Bookshelf
description: A study shelf holding textbooks, personal notebooks, and well-used reference books.

name: Gas Stove
description: A two-burner stainless steel stove connected to a domestic gas cylinder.

stateDescriptions.off: The stove burners are cool and extinguished.
stateDescriptions.on: A steady blue ring of flame hisses softly.
stateDescriptions.cooking: A pan is sizzling pleasantly, releasing delicious aromas.

name: Refrigerator
description: A modern double-door refrigerator stocked with milk, vegetables, snacks, and chilled water.

stateDescriptions.closed: The refrigerator stands humming quietly with its door sealed shut.
stateDescriptions.open: A rush of chilled air spills out, lighting up shelves filled with fresh food and juices.

name: Granite Countertop
description: A gleaming black granite slab used for chopping and meal preparation.

name: Kitchen Sink
description: A stainless steel wash sink equipped with a swivel gooseneck tap.

stateDescriptions.idle: The sink is dry and clean.
stateDescriptions.running_tap: A clean stream of water splashes smoothly down the stainless drain.

name: Dining Stool
description: A tall wooden counter stool suited for quick meals or resting while cooking.

name: Glass Tumbler
description: A clear glass tumbler for drinking water or juice.

stateDescriptions.empty: The glass is dry and clean.
stateDescriptions.filled_water: Clear, refreshing water fills the glass to the brim.

name: Steel Dinner Plate
description: A traditional polished stainless steel thali plate.

stateDescriptions.with_food: A freshly cooked warm meal of dal, rice, warm rotis and sabzi is arranged on the plate.

name: Toilet
description: A spotless white ceramic toilet with dual-flush buttons.

stateDescriptions.clean: The toilet is clean and ready for use.

name: Washbasin
description: A ceramic sink with chrome faucet, soap dispenser, and toothbrush stand.

name: Bathroom Mirror
description: A frameless glass mirror mounted over the washbasin.

stateDescriptions.clear: The mirror gives a crisp, true reflection.
stateDescriptions.foggy: Warm steam blankets the mirror surface in a hazy mist.

name: Shower
description: An overhead chrome rain shower head mounted above tiled flooring with drainage.

stateDescriptions.running: Warm streams of water cascade down in a relaxing deluge.

name: Mohit's Phone

name: Bathroom Light

name: Math Textbook
